titulo: ‘There’s a lot more heat coming’: world has six consecutive days 2C above preindustrial levels for first time
cuerpo: Hot streak rose to record-breaking 2.4C above baseline levels on Monday and is forecast to continue for several days For the first time, the world has experienced six consecutive days of temperatures that are 2 degrees Celsius warmer than preindustrial levels, the Guardian has learned. This record hot streak , which is continuing, is too brief to signify the upper range of the Paris climate agreement target has been breached, but scientists said it is an early indication of what is to come unless fossil fuel emissions are rapidly eliminated.
